title: I’ve loved @lesmisofficial for as long as I can remember, so getting ...
transcript: Les Miz is one of the musicals that made me fall in love with musical theater. The story, the characters, the music. I genuinely don't think I could see the show without crying. So getting to experience Les Miz the Arena Concert Spectacular was truly a theater kid dream come true. This is Les Miz on a scale you've never seen before. A cast and orchestra of over 65 people. Massive, stunning orchestrations to one of the most beautiful scores of all time. Incredible performances, and one of the most beautiful venues in New York City. And a production that feels enormous without losing any of the emotions that center the story. The audience, to me, made the night even more special. I was surrounded by Les Mis fans and who were just locked into every second, gasping at all the right moments, cheering for entrances, weeping together for Fantine and Eponine, and a full standing ovation at the end of one day more. There is truly nothing like being surrounded by thousands of people who love something as much as you do. I spent the entire show either beaming or crying, stunned by what I was seeing on the stage. I was really just completely in. Whether Lay Miz has been part of your life for decades or if you're introducing this show to someone for the very first time, this is truly one of the most unique and special ways to experience it, and I would recommend it to Everyone, seeing one of my favourite musicals inside Radio City Music Hall is truly something I will never forget. Les Miserables the Arena concert spectacular is only playing through August 9. You can't miss it. It really is that spectacular.
reasoning: Overwhelmingly enthusiastic first-hand review with explicit strong recommendation and urgent 'can't miss it' call to action.
